name: threadpage
description: Connect a Codex session to ThreadPage under its own name. On ThreadPage Pro with Sync, it reads and adds notes and takes the requests you address to it; otherwise, it only adds notes to your Inbox.

interface.longDescription: Each Codex session you connect gets its own name, access and activity in ThreadPage. On ThreadPage Pro with Sync on, it reads your threads, adds notes, and takes the requests you address to it, with the session's own permissions. On Free, or on Pro without Sync, it only adds notes to your Inbox; a name whose access you never changed follows your plan once you're on Pro with Sync on.
